VTU CURRICULUM

Course: Community Project (1BCP308)

Visvesvaraya Technological University, Belagavi, Karnataka

Project Domain

Smart Governance & Civic Tech

Target Community

Local College Town / Urban Ward

Sustainable Development Goals

SDG 11 & SDG 16

1. Problem Statement

In semi-urban areas and student neighborhoods around educational institutions, civic problems like recurring potholes, overflowing garbage receptacles, burnt streetlights, and drainage blocks often go unnoticed or delayed due to the lack of an accessible, transparent, and direct reporting channel between citizens and municipal maintenance squads.

2. Proposed Solution

JanaSeva provides a lightweight web interface where residents and college students report grievances with photo evidence, landmark localization, and urgency tags. It automatically generates unique tracking codes, displays public resolution timelines, and ensures citizen privacy without exposing sensitive personal data.

3. UN SDG Alignment

  • SDG 11: Sustainable Cities & Communities – Target 11.6: Managing municipal solid waste and improving municipal infrastructure quality.
  • SDG 16: Strong Institutions – Promoting responsive, inclusive, participatory, and representative civic decision-making.

4. Key Viva Questions Answered

Q: How is citizen privacy maintained?
A: The system only records public landmarks (e.g. Near Main Gate) and an optional citizen pseudonym. No private home address or mobile number is exposed on the public dashboard.
